essential_functions.meaning: Tell when the plants need water
Decide on its own when to start and stop watering

Get water from some supply it can draw on

What power is available where the plants are

essential_functions.meaning: Discourage pigeons from landing or staying on the balcony

cases.notes: Gulf Arabic. Two explicit exclusions: no harm to birds, no loud noise.

essential_functions.meaning: Keep the times at which medicine should be taken
Remind the father at each of those times in a way he notices
Find out whether the medicine was actually taken
Tell the person (the son or daughter) when a dose was not taken in time

expected_unknowns.meaning: How many medicines and daily times there are
How the person wants to be told (and whether they are in the same home)
Whether the father can easily hear, see or handle small controls

cases.notes: MSA. Reminder plus remote notification of missed dose; detection of taking is the open part. No medical claim should be made.

Be usable inside a car

adjudication.statement: The adjudicator saw no candidate prompt, schema, scoring code, earlier pack or model response for this evaluation and reviewed only the two held-out v2 fixture files at base commit 2da3ffea0522f5818a5bd3e04dc3b5f9d1b3a291.

changes.Q10: Q10-F2 'Switch the bike light on' -> 'Switch the light on': the idea's 'its light' may be the gadget's own light, so the reference must not presume an existing bike light (Q10-U2 already asks this).
changes.Q13: Q13-F1 dropped 'or about to start': the idea asks to be alerted when the rain starts (لما المطرة تبتدي); predicting rain is a proposal, not a stated essential function (the forecast option stays in meaningful_choice).
changes.Q15: Q15-X2 meaning 'A phone app' -> 'An app on the son's phone': the exclusion is 'without an app on his phone', not every phone app (e.g. a parent's).
changes.Q16: Q16-F4 'Show the daughter' -> 'Let the daughter know': the idea says 'lets her know', so the reference must not presume a visual indication; Q16-U2 reworded because the original sentence was garbled and unclear.
